definitions.gloss: harvest season; harvest time; harvesting period
definitions.explanation: The time of year when crops are ready to be gathered. Also used figuratively for the period when results of one's efforts become apparent.

examples.japanese: {稲|いね}の{収穫期|しゅうかくき}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: The rice harvest season has arrived.

examples.japanese: {収穫期|しゅうかくき}になると{農家|のうか}は{忙|いそが}しくなる。
examples.english: Farmers get busy when harvest season comes.

examples.japanese: ぶどうの{収穫期|しゅうかくき}は{地域|ちいき}によって{異|こと}なるが、{秋|あき}が{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: The grape harvest season varies by region, but autumn is typical.

notes:
Compound of {収穫|しゅうかく} (harvest) + {期|き} (period). Primarily an agricultural term, but can be used metaphorically for when efforts bear fruit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}を{迎|むか}える: to reach harvest season
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}に{入|はい}る: to enter harvest season
- {収穫期|しゅうかくき}の{農家|のうか}: farmers during harvest

RELATED TERMS:
- {収穫|しゅうかく}: harvest (the act or result)
- {植|う}え{付|つ}け: planting (the beginning of the agricultural cycle)
- {作付|さくづ}け: cultivation; crop planting
- {実|みの}りの{秋|あき}: fruitful autumn (poetic expression for harvest season)
